svg.text: One broker, one topic. Records are keyed by source row, so every version of a row lands in the same partition, in order.
offsets 0, 1, 2 … oldest to newest; each partition is an ordered log
same key → same partition → versions stay in order
at least once; bronze ignores repeats
Single broker in KRaft mode (no ZooKeeper)
Topic created once by kafka-init; auto-create is off
Containers connect on kafka:19092; the host only on 127.0.0.1:9092
No Schema Registry, Kafka Connect or stream processing
Replays come from Kafka retention or from xom_source
